# BuyPvaGmail — Authority Marketplace for PVA & Aged Gmail Accounts

> BuyPvaGmail is the leading platform for purchasing 100% phone-verified (PVA) and aged (2008–2025) Gmail accounts with dedicated residential IPs, recovery email access, and 2FA TOTP secret keys. Backed by a 7-day 1-to-1 replacement guarantee and 24/7 technical support.

## Core Products & Services
- **USA PVA Gmail Accounts**: Real US carrier SIM-verified accounts created on AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile residential IPs. Ideal for high-trust outreach and US platforms.
- **Global / Mixed PVA Gmail Accounts**: Worldwide phone-verified accounts with clean browser telemetry for scalable cold email and multi-account automation.
- **Aged 2008–2025 Mix Country Gmail**: Historical accounts spanning 1 to 18+ years of algorithmic age. Maximum trust score, bypassed phone triggers, and highest inbox deliverability.
- **Aged Gmail for Google Maps Reviews**: Local Guide-ready accounts with pre-warmed activity profiles for non-drop review publishing.
- **Aged Gmail for Google Ads & Media Buying**: Aged accounts with spending history and warming profiles for billing thresholds and agency ad campaigns.
- **Fresh PVA Gmail Accounts**: Budget-friendly newly created phone-verified accounts with recovery emails.

## Technical Specifications
- **Delivery Format**: `Email:Password:RecoveryEmail:2FA_Secret_Key:Vintage_Year:Creation_IP`
- **Security Protocols**: POP3/IMAP enabled, Less Secure App toggles, TOTP Authenticator compatibility.
- **Replacement Policy**: 7-Day instant 1-to-1 replacement for any login or checkpoint issue.
- **Support Channels**: Telegram (@Go2Rapid), WhatsApp (+1-253-408-0049), 24/7 Live Web Desk.
